title: Gymnastics Progression Readiness by Prerequisite
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gymnastics:skill
| stats avg(readiness_pct) as readiness_pct count as tracked_skills by prerequisite_skill
| sort 0 - readiness_pct
description: Ranks prerequisite skillss by progression readiness.
value: Prerequisite-based readiness helps coaches and athletes know what must be stable before the next skill jump makes sense.
implementation: Send progression readiness events to `index=personal` and keep `prerequisite_skill` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of progression readiness by prerequisite skills.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which prerequisite skillss stand out most for progression readiness.
